notes:
Make2D layouts, a simpler Trim and Split workflow and one-click options.

### New
- Make2D layouts: Current view, Current CPlane and 4-view in third- or first-angle arrangement; Maintain source layers keeps the output organised by the original layers under Make2D › Visible and Hidden.
- Trim: select the cutting objects, then click each part to remove, with a hover preview; Split: select objects to split, then the cutting objects. Both offer ApparentIntersections to cut where objects cross in the current view.
- Options with two values switch with a single click, or Enter/Space.

### Improved
- Clearer command prompts in Trim and Split.
- Section now sits with the curves from objects; Check mesh and Mesh distance sit with the mesh tools.
- Insert from the Block Manager goes straight to the insertion point.

### Fixed
- Diameter highlights the full diameter instead of the radius.
- FilletSrf and ChamferSrf no longer extend a surface unnecessarily; a partial overlap is filleted only along the shared section.
- ChamferSrf, Mesh repair and Edit block icons use the correct colours.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
